io.milvus.v2.service.utility

Class UtilityService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.BaseService
      • io.milvus.v2.service.utility.UtilityService

  • public class UtilityService
extends BaseService
    Service for utility operations, such as flushing, compacting, aliases, health checks, and segment information queries.
